title: Market Research data quality report (mr.quality/1)
description: Coverage, unresolved cards, parser failures, link mismatches and drift warnings. Keys and counts only; no payloads or personal data.

schema.description: Schema ID and major version of this file.

version.description: Snapshot version this file belongs to: the UTC start time of the pipeline run that published it, as YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSSZ. Same as the v=<version>/ folder the file is in and the manifest's version.

coverage.description: How much data the snapshot is built from, over every normalized tournament.

tournaments.description: Tournaments after normalization (Standard, past the guards).

tournaments_with_games.description: Of those, the tournaments with game results (pairings from Cobra).

tournaments_high_coverage.description: Tournaments with decklist coverage at least thresholds.coverage_hc and a top cut (the ones conversion uses).

mean_decklist_coverage.description: Average decklist coverage over the tournaments (0-1).

legal_decks.description: Decks that pass the legality checks; only these reach the metrics.

decks_by_source.description: Decks per source: import (a decklist file loaded with import-decks, e.g. from the organiser), cobra (the list registered in Cobra), nrdb_decklist (a published NetrunnerDB decklist claimed on ABR) or nrdb_deck (a NetrunnerDB deck referenced by Cobra).

deck_comparison.description: How many decks had each comparison result between the deck used and the next source (import, then Cobra, then NetrunnerDB): match, mismatch, import_only, cobra_only or nrdb_only.

unresolved_cards.description: Card references that don't match the catalog, as printing:<id> or card:<id>, with how many times each was seen. Those cards are left out of their decks.

unresolved_identities.description: Identity names that don't match the catalog, with how many times each was seen.

parser_failures.description: Source responses that couldn't be parsed and were quarantined, with no payload content.

key.description: Storage key of the source record.

error.description: The parse error, cut to 200 characters.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the rejected payload (sha256:<hex>), to recognise repeats.

link_mismatches.description: Cobra tournaments or entries that couldn't be linked to AlwaysBeRunning: tid, reason (e.g. abr_code_unresolved, ambiguous_fallback_match, fallback_identities_differ, identity_mismatch) and, for an entry, entry_no.

links.description: Cobra tournaments linked to an AlwaysBeRunning event: tid, abr_id and method (abr_code, or date_size_identities when matched by date, player count and identities).

drift_warnings.description: Fields a source returned that the parser doesn't know, per payload kind (e.g. abr.tournament). Names only, never values; a sign the source's API changed.

rejected_deck_refs.description: Deck links from AlwaysBeRunning that aren't a recognised NetrunnerDB deck or decklist URL, so they were not followed.

skipped_tournaments.description: Tournaments left out, per reason (e.g. not_standard, too_small, abr_guard, cobra_no_results, abr_no_entries).

restriction_overrides.description: Tournaments whose ban list was replaced by the one most of their decks are legal under: tid, from, to, decks, legal_before and legal_after.
